# Node Weekly

A newsletter: editors pick a handful of tools per issue, so your one-liner has to be the hook.

Notes from the directory list: Email editor.

## Steps
1. Open https://nodeweekly.com/ and find the tips/submission form or the right editor's contact.
2. Write a pitch from `copy.press_pitch` with one hook specific to this outlet (under 150 words, skill/human-writing).
3. `launchkit draft node-weekly -` and mark `drafted`. Submit a web form only if `pitch` mode is enabled and the user approved it.

## Make the listing perform
- Submit through the free "suggest a tool" form if there is one. Sponsor slots are paid, so skip them at budget 0.
